drugRefs.composition: ciprofloxacin or based on prior culture
drugRefs.regimenLabel: Ciprofloxacin (if local resistance acceptable) or based on prior culture
drugRefs.why: Provides reliable broad coverage of typical complicated UTI pathogens; duration extended relative to uncomplicated cystitis given higher relapse risk.

drugRefs.regimenLabel: Ceftriaxone (if oral therapy not tolerated or resistance suspected)
drugRefs.duration: 7-14 days (step down to oral when able)
drugRefs.coverage: Used when fluoroquinolone resistance is suspected or oral therapy is not feasible.

coverageMatrix.completeness: Coverage should ideally be culture-confirmed given the higher resistance burden in complicated UTI.
gaps: Enterococcus is not covered by either regimen - add amoxicillin if confirmed on culture.
Empiric coverage should be reassessed against prior urine culture history if available.

stewardship.deescalation: Narrow to the most targeted oral agent once urine culture and sensitivity are available, and shorten duration if clinical response is rapid and the complicating factor has been addressed.

drugs.drug: Ciprofloxacin (if local resistance acceptable) or based on prior culture
drugs.why: Provides reliable broad coverage of typical complicated UTI pathogens; duration extended relative to uncomplicated cystitis given higher relapse risk.

drugs.drug: Ceftriaxone (if oral therapy not tolerated or resistance suspected)
drugs.duration: 7-14 days (step down to oral when able)
drugs.coverage: Used when fluoroquinolone resistance is suspected or oral therapy is not feasible.

framework: Send urine culture before starting therapy whenever possible - empiric choice should be reviewed once results return given the higher resistance burden in this population.
Avoid reflexive carbapenem use; reserve for confirmed ESBL organisms.
Address and correct the underlying complicating factor where feasible (e.g., catheter removal/change) as part of source control.
